mentorTrainings.name: Weight of the Cue I
mentorTrainings.description: Stone makes you repeat the same full stroke until the cue stops feeling like a tool and starts moving with your body.

mentorTrainings.name: Weight of the Cue II
mentorTrainings.description: He adds long-table force and asks for the same finish every time. Strength only counts when the cue ball obeys.

mentorTrainings.name: Weight of the Cue III
mentorTrainings.description: The final drill is heavy, quiet, and exact. Stone only nods when the cue ball stops where you decided it would.

mentorTrainings.name: The Quiet Line I
mentorTrainings.description: Aya removes every distraction from the table and teaches you to let the shot line arrive before your hand moves.

mentorTrainings.name: The Quiet Line II
mentorTrainings.description: The same line becomes thinner, slower, and less forgiving. Aya watches your breathing more than the pocket.

mentorTrainings.name: The Quiet Line III
mentorTrainings.description: Aya says stability is not the absence of nerves. It is sending the ball home while the nerves are still there.

mentorTrainings.name: Break the Pattern I
mentorTrainings.description: Ren scatters the rack and asks which shot would make the other player hate their next turn.

mentorTrainings.name: Break the Pattern II
mentorTrainings.description: The drill turns ugly leaves into pressure. Ren calls it chaos management, but every risk has a purpose.

mentorTrainings.name: Break the Pattern III
mentorTrainings.description: Ren makes you attack from bad layouts until imperfect tables start feeling like invitations instead of problems.

mentorTrainings.name: Soft Hands I
mentorTrainings.description: Eline makes you move the cue ball with the smallest possible force. Every hidden push shows up in the leave.

mentorTrainings.name: Soft Hands II
mentorTrainings.description: She adds spin, silence, and distance control until soft contact becomes harder than a power stroke.

mentorTrainings.name: Soft Hands III
mentorTrainings.description: The final touch drill barely makes a sound. The cue ball stops as if it knew the route before you struck it.

mentorTrainings.name: No Second Chance I
mentorTrainings.description: Jin leaves one simple black ball on the table and asks whether it still feels simple when the match depends on it.

mentorTrainings.name: No Second Chance II
mentorTrainings.description: He turns every drill into a last rack. The shot does not change, but the player holding the cue does.

mentorTrainings.name: No Second Chance III
mentorTrainings.description: Jin puts the final ball back in your hand and tells you to remember its weight before the yacht tables begin.

mentorTrainings.name: Play to Be Seen I
mentorTrainings.description: Gloria turns the lights on and lets the room watch. Attention is not the enemy if you stop apologizing for it.

mentorTrainings.name: Play to Be Seen II
mentorTrainings.description: The yacht table becomes a stage. Gloria makes you hold your posture after the shot instead of hiding from it.

mentorTrainings.name: Play to Be Seen III
mentorTrainings.description: For the final class, Gloria asks you to take the table like the room already remembers your name.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The hall is quiet when you step inside. One open table waits beneath the lights.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: This is where my story begins.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You tighten your grip on the cue and take the first step forward.

lines.speaker: Stone
lines.text: New face. You here to watch or to put money down?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Depends on whether the table is open.

lines.speaker: Stone
lines.text: It is now. Bring your house cue and keep up.

lines.speaker: Stone
lines.text: Eighty in. If you scratch, I do not give lectures.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Good. I came for a match, not a class.

lines.speaker: Stone
lines.text: Fine. The cash is yours. Next one is double pressure.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Keep the table warm.

lines.speaker: Stone
lines.text: Money first. Pride later.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: You will get both back next time.

lines.speaker: Stone
lines.text: Two sets. No excuse left.

lines.speaker: Stone
lines.text: Take the Carbon Drive. If you can beat it, you can use it.

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.text: Power opens doors. Position decides which door you wanted.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Then I will try not to stand in the wrong room.

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.text: You learned the table speed. The Rosewood Touch will not fight you.

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.text: Take it. You did a great job!

lines.speaker: Jin
lines.text: Your patterns are getting cleaner. Let us see if they hold under league pressure.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Then I will keep the cue ball honest.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: No crowd. No noise. Just patterns.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: The Ebony Line is yours. Keep your shape small.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: I hope you find it easy to use.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.text: Straight lines are for people with no imagination.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.text: Take the Ivory Masse. Try not to make every shot dramatic.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: The table is steady even when the ship is not. Let us see which one you follow.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I will keep my eyes on the cue ball.

lines.speaker: Gloria
lines.text: The sea makes everyone look calm. The table tells me who actually is.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Then I will let the table introduce me.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: You handled that last game pretty well.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: The bar is still open. Come have one drink with me before you leave?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: All right. One drink, then I call it a night.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: Good. Then spend that hundred like it bought you a calmer stroke.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Few glasses of wine later...

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: i'm so drunk...

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I'll call a taxi for you.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: Thanks dude...

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: ...Naomi?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Not tonight. I need to keep my head clear.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: Practical. A little dull, but practical.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Wake up, Naomi!

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: Don't speek...Idiot.

lines.speaker: Eline
lines.text: Eline is ready for a set.

lines.speaker: Daichi Matsuoka
lines.text: Daichi Matsuoka is ready for a set.

lines.speaker: Mika Hayase
lines.text: Mika Hayase is ready for a set.

lines.speaker: Ralph
lines.text: Ralph is ready for a set.

lines.speaker: Nana Shirogane
lines.text: Nana Shirogane is ready for a set.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: Naomi
lines.text: So, what next?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Straight home

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.text: Good job, lad.

lines.text: Mateo is ready for a set.

lines.speaker: Kaspi
lines.text: You have beaten my patience. Now the Golden Room wants to know whether you can beat Gloria's freedom.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: And if I do?

lines.speaker: Kaspi
lines.text: Then we can finally discuss the one possession you have never stopped trying to recover.

lines.speaker: Gloria
lines.text: You won without asking the table to decide your whole life for you. Keep that part.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: There is still one thing waiting beneath the water.

lines.speaker: Kaspi
lines.text: The wreck, its coordinates, and every salvage right attached to it: five hundred thousand. I will not lower the price, and I will not sell it twice.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Then keep the papers ready. I am bringing it home.

lines.speaker: Kaspi
lines.text: The transfer is complete. Title, coordinates, and salvage rights. I kept the ship as a story. You paid enough to decide how that story ends.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Months later, the hull rises from the private water. The repairs do not make it luxurious. They return the plain wheel, the worn rails, and the honest marks of work.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I did not buy back the past. I made a place for it to come home.

zh-CN.dialogues.main-story-opening.title: 新的开始
zh-CN.dialogues.main-story-opening.lines.0.tex: 当你踏入大厅时，四周一片寂静。灯光下，一张空桌静静等待着。
zh-CN.dialogues.main-story-opening.lines.1.tex: 我的���事就从这里开始了。
zh-CN.dialogues.main-story-opening.lines.2.tex: 你紧紧握住球杆，迈出第一步。
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-intro.title: 第一声回响
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-intro.lines.0.speaker: 斯通
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-intro.lines.0.text: 新面孔。你是来看比赛的，还是想押注？
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-intro.lines.1.speaker: 玩家
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-intro.lines.2.speaker: 石头
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-intro.lines.2.text: 现在有空了。带上你的球杆，跟上节奏。
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-pre.title: 压力局
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-pre.lines.0.speaker: 石头
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-pre.lines.0.text: 八十分。如果你犯规，我就不多说了。
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-pre.lines.1.speaker: 玩家
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-pre.lines.1.text: 很好。我是来比赛的，不是来上课的。
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-win.title: 赢得奖金
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-win.lines.0.speaker: 石头
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-win.lines.0.text: 行吧，钱归你了。下一局加倍压力。
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-win.lines.1.speaker: 玩家
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-loss.title: 输掉赌注
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-loss.lines.0.speaker: 石头
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-loss.lines.1.speaker: 玩家
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-loss.lines.1.text: 下次你会连本带利都拿回���的。
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-defeated.title: 终结者
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-defeated.lines.0.speaker: 石头
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-defeated.lines.1.speaker: 石头
zh-CN.dialogues.stone-defeated.lines.1.text: 拿走碳素杆。如果你能打败它，就能使用它。
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-pre.title: 控球课
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-pre.lines.0.speaker: 林
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-pre.lines.0.text: 力量打开大门，位置决定你想进哪扇门。
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-pre.lines.1.speaker: 玩家
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-pre.lines.1.text: 那我尽量别站错房间了。
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-defeated.title: 柔触
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-defeated.lines.0.speaker: 林
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-defeated.lines.0.text: 你已掌握球速，红木触感不会再与你为敌。
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-defeated.lines.1.speaker: 林
zh-CN.dialogues.lin-defeated.lines.1.text: 收下吧。你做得非常出色！
zh-CN.dialogues.jin-pre.title: 城市杯
zh-CN.dialogues.jin-pre.lines.0.speaker: 金
zh-CN.dialogues.jin-pre.lines.0.text: 你的走位越来越干��了。让我们看看在联赛的压力下能否保持水准。
zh-CN.dialogues.jin-pre.lines.1.speaker: 玩家
zh-CN.dialogues.jin-pre.lines.1.text: 那我就让母球乖乖听话吧。
zh-CN.dialogues.aya-pre.title: 静谧桌台
zh-CN.dialogues.aya-pre.lines.0.speaker: 绫
zh-CN.dialogues.aya-pre.lines.0.text: 没有观众，没有喧嚣，只有纯粹的走位。
zh-CN.dialogues.aya-defeated.title: 线条作业
zh-CN.dialogues.aya-defeated.lines.0.speaker: 绫
zh-CN.dialogues.aya-defeated.lines.0.text: 黑檀木杆归你了。保持紧凑的击球形状。
zh-CN.dialogues.aya-defeated.lines.1.speaker: 绫
zh-CN.dialogues.ren-pre.title: 展示赛
zh-CN.dialogues.ren-pre.lines.0.speaker: 莲
zh-CN.dialogues.ren-pre.lines.0.text: 直线是给那些缺乏想象力的人准备的���
zh-CN.dialogues.ren-defeated.title: 不可能的角度
zh-CN.dialogues.ren-defeated.lines.0.speaker: 莲
zh-CN.dialogues.ren-defeated.lines.0.text: 收下象牙色巧粉杆吧。尽量别让每一杆都显得那么戏剧化。
zh-CN.dialogues.naomi-pre.title: 巡航休息室套装
zh-CN.dialogues.naomi-pre.lines.0.speaker: 娜奥米
zh-CN.dialogues.naomi-pre.lines.0.text: 即使船只摇晃，桌台依然稳固。让我们看看你会跟随哪一方。
zh-CN.dialogues.naomi-pre.lines.1.speaker: 玩家

zh-CN.npcTasks.street-room-beer-delivery.title: 老顾客的啤酒配送
zh-CN.npcTasks.street-room-beer-delivery.descr: 在晚间座位坐满之前，给一位常客送上一罐啤酒。
zh-CN.npcTasks.street-room-sparring-partner.de: 为 Stone 提供开球练习、重新摆球，并配合进行三小时的受控训练模式。
清洁台呢布、整理俱乐部球杆，并协助常客寻找空闲球桌。
zh-CN.npcTasks.community-club-chalk-purchase.d: 使用预存店铺资金购买一支球杆巧粉，并将其归还至俱乐部柜台。
花费三小时记录 Lin 的速度控制训练结果。
zh-CN.npcTasks.stone-rematch-task.title: Stone 的桌台测试
zh-CN.npcTasks.stone-rematch-task.description: Stone 希望在认定你可靠之前，再与你进行一场压力局对决。
zh-CN.npcTasks.lin-chalk-delivery.title: Lin 的新鲜巧粉
zh-CN.npcTasks.lin-chalk-delivery.description: Lin 请在下一堂速度控制课前为他送一支球杆巧粉。
zh-CN.npcTasks.aya-quiet-tea.title: 安静桌台茶叙
zh-CN.npcTasks.aya-quiet-tea.description: Aya 邀请你在闭店后坐下，共同探讨走位选择。
zh-CN.npcTasks.ren-afterparty.title: 展示赛后派对
zh-CN.npcTasks.ren-afterparty.description: Ren 希望在精彩对决结束后，与你进行一场深夜聚会。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.stone-weight-cue-i.name: 球杆重量 I
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.stone-weight-cue-i.descr: 石头让你重复同样的完整击球动作，直到球杆不再感觉像一件工具，而是与你身体融为一体。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.stone-weight-cue-ii.name: 球杆的重量 II
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.stone-weight-cue-ii.desc: 他增加了长台力度，并要求每次结束动作都完全一致。只有当母球听从指挥时，力量才算数。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.stone-weight-cue-iii.des: 最后的训练沉重、安静且精准。石头只在母球停在你预定的位置时才点头。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.aya-quiet-line-i.name: 静线 I
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.aya-quiet-line-i.descrip: Aya 移除了台面上的所有干扰，教你在动手之前让击球线路自然浮现。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.aya-quiet-line-ii.name: 静线 II
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.aya-quiet-line-ii.descri: 同样的线路变得更细、更慢、容错率更低。Aya 关注的更多是你的呼吸，而非袋口。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.aya-quiet-line-iii.name: 静线 III
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.aya-quiet-line-iii.descr: Aya 说稳定并非没有紧张感，而是在神经紧绷时仍将母球送入袋中。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.ren-break-pattern-i.name: 打破模式 I
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.ren-break-pattern-i.desc: Ren 散开摆球架，并问你哪一杆会让对手讨厌接下来的回合。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.ren-break-pattern-ii.des: 训练将杂乱的叶子转化为压力。Ren 称之为混乱管理，但每一次风险都有其目的。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.ren-break-pattern-iii.de: Ren 让你从糟糕的布局发起进攻，直到不完美的球台开始感觉像是邀请而非问题。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.eline-soft-hands-i.name: 柔手 I
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.eline-soft-hands-i.descr: Eline 让你用尽可能小的力量移动母球。每一次隐藏的推挤都会在走位中显现出来。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.eline-soft-hands-ii.name: 柔手 II
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.eline-soft-hands-ii.desc: 她加入了旋转、静音和距离控制，直到轻柔的接触变得比强力击球更难掌握。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.eline-soft-hands-iii.des: 最后的触感训练几乎无声。母球仿佛在你击打之前就已知道路线般停下。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.jin-no-second-chance-i.d: Jin 在桌上留下一颗简单的黑球，并问你当比赛胜负取决于它时，是否仍觉得简单。
他将每一次训练都变成最后一局摆球。击球动作未变，但握杆的人已不同。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.jin-no-second-chance-iii: Jin 将球放回你手中，告诉你要在游艇比赛开始前记住它的重量。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.gloria-play-seen-i.name: 为被看见而打球 I
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.gloria-play-seen-i.descr: Gloria 打开灯光，让全场注视。如果你不再为此道歉，那么关注就不是敌人。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.gloria-play-seen-ii.name: 为被看见而打球 II
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.gloria-play-seen-ii.desc: 游艇桌变成了舞台。格洛丽亚让你击球后保持姿势，而不是躲闪。
zh-CN.mentorTrainings.gloria-play-seen-iii.des: 在最后一节课中，格洛丽亚要求你像房间早已记住你的名字那样掌控球桌。

zh-CN.mentorTrainings.lin's master class.descr: 描述导师教授的内容以及玩家练习的项目。

zh-CN.randomEvents.wrist-strain.body: 幸运数字 {number}。昨天的练习后，你的支撑手感觉僵硬。今天的精细控制将更难。
zh-CN.randomEvents.sore-shoulder.title: 肩部酸痛
zh-CN.randomEvents.sore-shoulder.body: 幸运数字 {number}。肩部的酸痛使得满杆击球感觉更沉重。
zh-CN.randomEvents.cue-slip.title: 球杆打滑

zh-CN.randomEvents.tired-legs.title: 双腿疲惫
zh-CN.randomEvents.tired-legs.body: 幸运数字 {number}。你站立时间过长，今天的长局比赛会感觉更加沉重。
zh-CN.randomEvents.eye-fatigue.title: 眼睛疲劳
zh-CN.randomEvents.eye-fatigue.body: 幸运数字 {number}。你的眼睛很累，薄切球的命中率不如往常确定。

zh-CN.randomEvents.crowd-cheer.title: 观众欢呼

zh-CN.randomEvents.recipe-scrap.title: 配方残片

zh-CN.randomEvents.perfect-state.title: 完美状态

zh-CN.npcTasks.kaspi-buy-back-fathers-wreck.de: Kaspi 愿以五十万现金的价格，移交沉船产权与完整打捞权。
zh-CN.dialogues.main-story-golden-invitation.l: 你已经击败了我的耐心。现在，Golden Room 想知道你能否击败 Gloria 的自由。
那我们终于可以谈谈那件你从未停止寻找的东西。
zh-CN.dialogues.gloria-final-defeated.title: 最后的金色一局
你赢了，却没有要求这张球桌替你决定整个人生。把这一点留下。
水下还有一样东西在等我。
zh-CN.dialogues.kaspi-wreck-purchase-start.lin: 沉船、坐标，以及附属于它的全部打捞权：五十万。我不会降价，也不会把它卖第二次。
那就把文件准备好。我会带它回家。
交割完成。产权、坐标和打捞权。我把它保存成了一个故事，而你付出了足够的代价来决定故事如何结束。
几个月后，船体从私人海域升起。修复没有让它变得奢华，而是找回了朴素的舵轮、磨损的栏杆，以及劳动留下的真实痕迹。
我不是买回了过去。我只是为它找到了回家的位置。
zh-CN.milestones.story-arrival.title: 幸运台球厅的第一夜
zh-CN.milestones.story-arrival.description: 踏入球房、认识常客，主线故事由此展开。
zh-CN.milestones.first-bankroll.title: 第一桶金
zh-CN.milestones.first-bankroll.description: 手握五百现金，几局好运终于变成了真正的起步资金。
zh-CN.milestones.first-hall-win.title: 球房首胜
zh-CN.milestones.first-hall-win.description: 首场记录在案的剧情胜利，证明你能在本地球桌上站稳脚跟。
zh-CN.milestones.finding-your-stroke.title: 找到手感
zh-CN.milestones.finding-your-stroke.descripti: 达到五级后，反复练习终于开始形成属于自己的打法。
zh-CN.milestones.hot-hand.title: 手感火热
zh-CN.milestones.hot-hand.description: 剧情比赛三连胜，让整个球房都开始留意你。
zh-CN.milestones.stable-hustler.title: 站稳脚跟
zh-CN.milestones.stable-hustler.description: 声望达到三后，大家不再把你当成匆匆路过的新手。
zh-CN.milestones.first-cue-upgrade.title: 首次球杆升级
zh-CN.milestones.first-cue-upgrade.description: 第一次认真购入、修复或亲手制作的球杆升级，让装备系统真正运转起来。
zh-CN.milestones.first-friend.title: 第一个朋友
zh-CN.milestones.first-friend.description: 一段关系达到二十五亲密度，球房生活从此不再只有比赛。
zh-CN.milestones.first-job-finished.title: 靠双手赚钱
zh-CN.milestones.first-job-finished.descriptio: 完成第一个 NPC 任务，证明离开记分牌后你也值得信赖。
zh-CN.milestones.fresh-look.title: 焕然一新
zh-CN.milestones.fresh-look.description: 二阶服装说明你正逐渐配得上自己走进的房间。
zh-CN.milestones.small-cue-rack.title: 小小球杆架
zh-CN.milestones.small-cue-rack.description: 拥有三支球杆后，装备选择也成了个人风格的一部分。
zh-CN.milestones.city-league-entry.title: 踏入城市联赛
zh-CN.milestones.city-league-entry.description: 进入城市联赛层级，在更强的竞争者中赢得自己的位置。
zh-CN.milestones.first-rival-defeated.title: 击败劲敌
zh-CN.milestones.first-rival-defeated.descript: 战胜一位核心剧情对手，整个社交圈开始注意到你。
zh-CN.milestones.mentor-breakthrough.title: 导师突破
zh-CN.milestones.mentor-breakthrough.descripti: 导师课程带来认证，或是一项重要的技巧突破。
zh-CN.milestones.private-salon-invite.title: 私人沙龙邀请
zh-CN.milestones.private-salon-invite.descript: 声望与人际关系为你打开高赌注私人房间的大门。
zh-CN.milestones.after-hours-friends.title: 打烊后的朋友
zh-CN.milestones.after-hours-friends.descripti: 与球房常客建立高亲密度的场外关系里程碑。
zh-CN.milestones.monthly-cup-champion-trophy.d: 第一次捧起月度杯赛冠军奖杯。这张奖杯照只会解锁一次，之后再夺冠也不会重复。
zh-CN.milestones.gloria-unlocked.title: 格洛丽亚登场
zh-CN.milestones.gloria-unlocked.description: 在月度杯赛决赛中击败格洛丽亚后，她将作为球房邂逅角色解锁。
zh-CN.milestones.champion-showcase-entry.title: 冠军展示厅入场
zh-CN.milestones.champion-showcase-entry.descr: 进入精英展示厅，整座城市开始把你当作真正的竞争者。
zh-CN.milestones.final-rack.title: 终局球堆
zh-CN.milestones.final-rack.description: 格洛丽亚的最后一颗球落入金厅袋口，终局球台归于寂静。
zh-CN.milestones.home-from-the-deep.title: 深海归航
zh-CN.milestones.home-from-the-deep.descriptio: 沉船离开 Kaspi 的私人海域，重新成为记忆中那艘饱经风浪的旧船。
